channel.title: Songs of Praise
channel.desc: Katherine Jenkins visits L'Abri fellowship in Hampshire to explore Christian faith and hospitality. She finds out about L'Abri's history and meets a family from Australia who are volunteering there. Radzi Chinyanganya meets a former stockbroker who found faith and changed career to help house the homeless. Music comes from congregations across the UK, including O Worship the Lord in the Beauty of Holiness and Table of the Lord.
